margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">If an emerging growth company, indicate by check mark if the registrant has elected not to use the extended transition period for complying with any new or revised financial accounting standards provided pursuant to Section&#160;13(a) of the Exchange Act.&#8194;&#9744;</p> <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&#160;</p> <div style="line-height:1.0pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt;border-bottom:1px solid #000000">&#160;</div> <div style="line-height:3.0pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:2pt;border-bottom:1px solid #000000">&#160;</div></div></div> <p style="page-break-before:always"></p> <hr style="color:#999999;height:3px;width:100%;clear:both"/> <div style="text-align:center"> <div style="width:8.5in;text-align:left;margin-left: auto;margin-right: auto"> <p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:bold">Introductory Note.</p> <ix:nonNumeric name="dei:AmendmentDescription" contextRef="duration_2026-01-12_to_2026-01-12" id="Fact_2"><p style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">On January&#160;12, 2026, Fidelity National Information Services, Inc., a Georgia corporation (&#8220;FIS&#8221;), filed a Current Report on Form <span style="white-space:nowrap">8-K</span> with the Securities and Exchange Commission (the &#8220;Original <span style="white-space:nowrap">8-K&#8221;),</span> which reported that on January&#160;9, 2026, FIS completed its previously announced (i)&#160;acquisition of the Issuer Solutions business (the &#8220;Issuer Solutions Business&#8221;) from Global Payments Inc., a Georgia corporation (&#8220;Global Payments&#8221;) and (ii)&#160;sale of all of its equity interests in Worldpay Holdco, LLC, a Delaware limited liability company (&#8220;Worldpay&#8221;), pursuant to the transaction agreement, entered into on April&#160;17, 2025, by and among FIS, Global Payments, Total System Services LLC, a Delaware limited liability company and Worldpay.</p><p style="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">This Current Report on Form <span style="white-space:nowrap">8-K/A</span> (&#8220;Amendment No.&#160;1&#8221;) amends Item 9.01 of the Original <span style="white-space:nowrap">8-K</span> to include the financial statements and pro forma financial information required by Item 9.01 of Form <span style="white-space:nowrap">8-K.</span> This Amendment No.&#160;1 should be read in conjunction with the Original <span style="white-space:nowrap">8-K.</span> Except as set forth herein, no modifications have been made to information contained in the Original <span style="white-space:nowrap">8-K.</span></p><p style="font-size:18pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&#160;</p></ix:nonNumeric>
